title: Japan Grand Tour: Tokyo · Osaka · Kyoto · Nagoya: 15 days of JDM car culture, family adventures & first-time Japan magic across four cities
description: This is the ultimate Japan road trip for a car-obsessed family. From the neon canyons of Shinjuku to the legendary Daikoku Parking Area car meets, from the Toyota Commemorative Museum in Nagoya to go-karting through Tokyo's streets — every day weaves Japan's incredible automotive culture with family-friendly adventures and cultural depth. You'll bullet-train between cities, eat your way through Osaka's street food scene, explore ancient Kyoto temples on a whirlwind day trip, and return to Tokyo for a grand finale.

days.title: Welcome to Tokyo — Neon Overload
days.description: Land in Tokyo and dive into the sensory explosion. Check in at Shinjuku, stretch your legs through the city, and end the night in Kabukicho.

activities.name: Arrive & Settle In
activities.description: Activate JR Pass at airport, grab Suica IC cards, take Narita Express to Shinjuku.
details: JR Pass activation at airport station
Suica cards for trains, buses, vending machines
Shinjuku is the perfect central base

activities.name: Shinjuku & Kabukicho Night Walk
activities.description: Shake off jet lag in Shinjuku. Godzilla watches from above. Omoide Yokocho alleys lead to yakitori and izakayas.
details: Godzilla Head at Hotel Gracery — iconic photo spot
Omoide Yokocho — tiny smoke-filled yakitori alleys
Golden Gai — 200+ tiny bars in 6 alleys

days.title: Temples, Parks & Akihabara Overload
days.description: Tokyo ancient heart meets its electric soul. Senso-ji at dawn, Ueno museums, then Akihabara — anime, arcades, and model car shops.

activities.name: Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise-dori
activities.description: Tokyo oldest temple. Thunder Gate lantern, Nakamise-dori shopping street.
details: Kaminarimon (Thunder Gate) — the iconic red lantern photo
Try ningyo-yaki and melon pan from stalls
Shops open 9am — arrive early for tranquility

activities.name: Ueno Park & National Museum
activities.description: Ueno Park with zoo (giant pandas) and Tokyo National Museum samurai armor. Car fan heaven: Tamiya and Tomica die-cast JDM legends, Initial D arcade simulators, floors of electronics.
details: Ueno Zoo — giant pandas and Japan oldest zoo
National Museum — samurai swords, scrolls, pottery
🏎️ Tamiya Plamodel Factory — build-your-own kits
🎮 Initial D Arcade Stage — race on the classic mountain passes
🤖 Yodobashi Camera Akiba — 9 floors of tech

days.title: Shibuya Crossing, Harajuku & Street Go-Karting
days.description: Pure Tokyo energy. Cross the most famous intersection on earth, explore Harajuku fashion street, then go-kart through real Tokyo streets in costume.

activities.name: Shibuya Crossing & Hachiko
activities.description: Watch 3,000 people cross at once. Shibuya Sky observatory (230m) for the best aerial view. Towering torii gate leads into a forested sanctuary — ancient forest inside a mega-city.
details: Shibuya Sky — best bird's-eye view of the crossing
Hachiko statue — famous loyal dog meeting spot
Free entry — open sunrise to sunset
170,000 trees planted 100 years ago from all over Japan

activities.name: Harajuku & Takeshita Street
activities.description: Takeshita-dori: crepe shops, wild fashion stores, kawaii culture. Kids love the candy shops. Dress up in costumes and drive go-karts through real Tokyo streets alongside regular traffic. Legal, guided, and unforgettable.
details: Marion Crepes — original Harajuku crepe since 1976
Kiddy Land — 5 floors of toys and character goods
🏎️ Book with JapanKart or Street Kart
📋 International Driving Permit required — get from AAA before your trip
⏱️ 1-2 hour courses — 2-hour route covers more landmarks

days.title: 🚗 Yokohama — Nissan Gallery & Daikoku PA Car Meet
days.description: Pure car heaven. Free Nissan Global HQ Gallery, Cup Noodles Museum for the kids, then the legendary Daikoku PA JDM car meet at night.

activities.name: 🚗 Nissan Global Headquarters Gallery
activities.description: Free Nissan showroom in Yokohama — GT-R, heritage race cars, concept vehicles, interactive tech. 7 min walk from Yokohama Station.
details: 🏎️ FREE entry — GT-R, Z Proto, Formula E car, heritage Skylines
📸 Racing history from 1960s Hakosuka to modern GT-R
🎮 Interactive driving simulators
🕐 Open 10am–8pm daily

activities.name: Cup Noodles Museum
activities.description: Design your own Cup Noodles with custom flavors, learn ramen history, play in the noodle factory playground. Yokohama harbor district: Cosmo World amusement park, Red Brick Warehouse, beautiful waterfront walk.
details: Design your own Cup Noodles package and flavor combination
Chicken Ramen Factory — hand-make your own (book ahead)
Entry: around 500 yen
Cosmo Clock 21 — one of the world largest Ferris wheels
Red Brick Warehouse — shopping, cafes, seasonal events

activities.name: 🚗 Daikoku PA Night Car Meet
activities.description: THE legendary JDM car meet. Hundreds of modified cars — GT-Rs, Silvias, Supras, RWB Porsches, bosozoku vans. Book a guided tour since there is no public transit.
details: 🏎️ Book guided tour — Viator or Samurai Car Japan
📸 Bring a camera with good low-light capability
🌙 Busiest 10pm–1am — Golden Week nights are very active
⚠️ Respect the cars — do not touch, ask before photographing

days.title: Odaiba, Super Autobacs & Tokyo Tower Sunset
days.description: teamLab digital art, Unicorn Gundam, Super Autobacs (the ultimate car parts megastore), then Tokyo Tower at sunset to close your Tokyo chapter.

activities.name: teamLab Borderless — Azabudai Hills
activities.description: The world most famous digital art museum — immersive rooms where art moves and responds to touch.
details: Book online at teamlab.art — sells out fast during Golden Week
Wear white or light colors — projections look incredible on you
Allow 2-3 hours to explore

activities.name: Odaiba — Unicorn Gundam & DiverCity
activities.description: Yurikamome monorail across Rainbow Bridge. Life-size 20m Unicorn Gundam. Gundam Base shop, Round One entertainment. Two floors of JDM parts, wheels, aero kits, model cars, and accessories. Japan largest Autobacs — a car lover toy store.
details: Unicorn Gundam — 19.7m tall, transforms at scheduled times
Round One — bowling, arcade, basketball, trampoline park
🏎️ Japan largest Autobacs — two massive floors
🛒 Die-cast models, JDM license plate frames — great souvenirs
🔧 Parts from HKS, Cusco, Rays, WORK wheels

activities.name: Tokyo Tower at Sunset
activities.description: Tokyo original icon. Watch the city go from golden hour to a sea of lights. Glass floor panels kids love.
details: Main Deck: 1200 yen — Top Deck: 3000 yen
Arrive 30 min before sunset for the full transition

days.title: Bullet Train to Osaka — Dotonbori Street Food Night
days.description: Board the Shinkansen — Tokyo to Osaka in 2.5 hours at 300km/h. Settle into Namba, then unleash on Dotonbori neon-lit street food paradise.

activities.name: 🚄 Shinkansen to Osaka
activities.description: Your first bullet train. Board at Tokyo Station. Mt. Fuji on the right side (Row A/B). 300km/h — smoother than most cars.
details: 🗻 Sit right side (A/B seats) for Mt. Fuji views near Shin-Fuji
🍱 Buy an ekiben (station bento) at Tokyo Station — it is a ritual
📋 Reserve seats during Golden Week — they fill up

activities.name: Namba & Shinsaibashi
activities.description: Check in near Namba Station and explore the 600m Shinsaibashi covered shopping arcade leading straight to Dotonbori.
details: Shinsaibashi-suji — one of Japan longest covered arcades
Glico Running Man sign at the Dotonbori end

activities.name: Dotonbori Street Food Crawl
activities.description: Neon signs, giant 3D food displays, and the best street food in Japan. Eat everything.
details: Takoyaki — Kukuru or Gindaco for the crispiest octopus balls
Okonomiyaki — Mizuno or Fukutaro for Osaka-style savory pancake
Kushikatsu Daruma — deep-fried skewers (no double dipping!)

days.title: Universal Studios Japan — Full Family Day
days.description: Full day at USJ — Wizarding World of Harry Potter, Super Nintendo World, Jurassic Park, Minion Park. Let the kids run wild.

activities.name: USJ — Morning Rush
activities.description: Arrive early. Head to Super Nintendo World or Harry Potter first. Express Pass saves hours of waiting.
details: Super Nintendo World — Mario Kart ride is the star attraction
Harry Potter — Hogwarts Castle ride is incredible
Buy Express Pass online well in advance — essential during Golden Week

activities.name: More Rides & Shows
activities.description: Jurassic Park water ride, Minion Park, Jaws, Spider-Man. Afternoon parade is spectacular.
details: Jurassic Park — bring a poncho, you will get soaked
Minion Park — meet-and-greets and dark ride
Afternoon parade features all franchises

activities.name: Nighttime Spectacular
activities.description: Projections, fireworks, and music mapped onto Hogwarts Castle. Magical end to a magical day.
details: Check schedule for show times
Best viewed from the lake in front of Hogwarts

days.title: Osaka Castle, Shinsekai & Local Osaka Vibes
days.description: Osaka historic and retro side. The magnificent castle, Shinsekai district with Tsutenkaku Tower, and Abeno Harukas — Japan tallest building.

activities.name: Osaka Castle
activities.description: One of Japan most famous landmarks. Huge grounds with moats and stone walls. Museum covers samurai history inside the tower.
details: Castle tower entry: 600 yen — Grounds are free
Best photos from the southwest corner across the moat
Nishinomaru Garden is beautiful in spring

activities.name: Shinsekai District
activities.description: Osaka retro downtown — Tsutenkaku Tower, Biliken statue, and the best kushikatsu in the city. Japan tallest building (300m). 360-degree observation deck views over Osaka.
details: Tsutenkaku Tower — Osaka original tower, quirky and charming
Kushikatsu — Shinsekai invented it, try Yaekatsu or Daruma
Retro arcades and pachinko parlors everywhere
Abeno Harukas 300 — observation deck with city views
Tennoji Park Japanese garden nearby

days.title: Kyoto Day Trip — Temples, Bamboo & Torii Gates
days.description: The epic Kyoto day trip. Fushimi Inari 10,000 torii gates at sunrise, Arashiyama bamboo grove, Kinkaku-ji, and Kiyomizu-dera at sunset.

activities.name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
activities.description: Thousands of vermillion torii gates wind up Mt. Inari. Push higher for solitude and stunning valley views.
details: FREE entry — open 24/7, arrive by 7am to beat crowds
Full summit hike about 2 hours round trip
Fox statues everywhere — Inari sacred messengers
JR Nara Line from Osaka to Inari Station (30 min)

activities.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
activities.description: Walk through towering bamboo stalks that sway above you. Ethereal, otherworldly, unforgettable. Zen temple covered in gold leaf, reflected perfectly in the mirror pond.
details: 500m path — short but completely unforgettable
Iwatayama Monkey Park nearby — wild macaques with city views
Togetsukyo Bridge — scenic river crossing photo spot
Entry: 500 yen — calligraphy charm as your ticket
Reflection shot is best on a still, clear day

activities.name: Kiyomizu-dera at Sunset
activities.description: Kyoto most famous temple perched on wooden pillars over a hillside. Sunset views over Kyoto are breathtaking.
details: Entry: 400 yen · Open until 6pm
Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka — charming stone-paved lanes with shops
The wooden stage view at golden hour is iconic

days.title: 🚗 Nagoya — Toyota Commemorative Museum
days.description: Bullet train to Nagoya — Toyota birthplace. The Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology is unmissable for car lovers. Then Nagoya Castle and the Osu shopping district.

activities.name: 🚄 Shinkansen to Nagoya
activities.description: Shin-Osaka to Nagoya in 50 minutes on the Nozomi. Nagoya is Japan industrial heartland — birthplace of Toyota.
details: Shin-Osaka to Nagoya: 50 min (Nozomi) / 80 min (Hikari, JR Pass)
Store luggage at Nagoya Station coin lockers
Toyota Commemorative Museum is 15 min walk from Nagoya Station

activities.name: 🚗 Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
activities.description: Housed in Toyota original red-brick factory, tracing the journey from textile looms to world-class automobiles. Hands-on exhibits, robot demos, production line simulations. One of Japan most important castles, built by Tokugawa Ieyasu. Golden shachihoko on the roof are iconic.
details: 🏭 Original Toyota factory building — massive red brick
🏎️ Automobile Pavilion: design, testing, build process
🤖 Partner Robot demo — robots that play musical instruments
500 yen adults, 200 yen kids · Closed Mondays
Allow 3-4 hours — there is so much to see
Entry: 500 yen · Honmaru Palace is a must-see
Golden shachihoko on the roof — Nagoya symbol

activities.name: Osu Shopping District
activities.description: Nagoya answer to Akihabara meets Harajuku. Retro shops, anime stores, street food, lively temple market atmosphere.
details: Osu Kannon Temple — start your walk here
Retro game shops and anime stores
Street food stalls — try Nagoya tebasaki (fried chicken wings)

days.title: 🚗 Toyota Automobile Museum — 140 Cars Across 100 Years
days.description: The crown jewel day for car lovers. 140+ cars spanning 100+ years of automotive history — Japanese, European, and American classics across 3 beautifully curated floors.

activities.name: 🚗 Toyota Automobile Museum
activities.description: 140+ cars from the 1890s to modern day. Three floors of automotive history — Toyota 2000GT, Jaguar E-Type, Porsche 356, American muscle, and more.
details: 🏎️ Japanese classics: Toyota 2000GT, Nissan Fairlady Z, Honda S800
🇪🇺 European classics: Jaguar E-Type, Porsche 356, Ferrari
🇺🇸 American muscle — Corvettes, Mustangs, Cadillacs
1200 yen adults, 600 yen kids · Open 9:30am–5pm
30 min by Linimo train from Nagoya — Geidai-dori Station

activities.name: SCMAGLEV and Railway Park
activities.description: Japan train history museum — from steam locomotives to the 603km/h magnetic levitation Shinkansen. Kids can ride Shinkansen driving simulators.
details: Full-size trains you can walk through — Shinkansen to steam
Driving simulators for different train types
1000 yen · Near Nagoya Port

days.neighborhoods: Nagoya to Hakone · Lake Ashi · Owakudani
days.title: Hakone — Hot Springs, Mt. Fuji Views & Onsen Night
days.description: Travel from Nagoya to Hakone — a mountain resort famous for hot springs, volcanic landscapes, and Mt. Fuji views. The winding mountain roads will thrill any car enthusiast. Soak in onsen tonight.

activities.name: 🚄 Nagoya to Hakone
activities.description: Shinkansen from Nagoya to Odawara (1h40m), then Hakone Tozan train into the mountains. Buy the Hakone Free Pass for unlimited transport.
details: Hakone Free Pass covers all local transport for 2-3 days
Hakone Tozan Railway — switchback mountain train
Clear days offer Mt. Fuji views throughout Hakone

activities.name: Hakone Open-Air Museum
activities.description: Stunning sculpture park set against mountain backdrops. Picasso Pavilion, huge outdoor installations, and a foot bath with mountain views. Active volcanic valley with sulfurous vents. Hakone Ropeway for aerial views. Eat a black egg — boiled in volcanic springs.
details: Outdoor sculptures by Picasso, Henry Moore, and more
Natural hot spring foot bath inside the museum
1600 yen adults · Kid-friendly play sculptures
Kuro-tamago (black eggs) — 500 yen for 5
Hakone Ropeway — stunning aerial views
Active volcanic zone — sulfur smell is strong

activities.name: Onsen (Hot Spring Bath)
activities.description: Your first Japanese onsen. Hakone is famous for its hot springs. Many ryokans offer private family baths — the ultimate way to relax.
details: Many hotels and ryokans have private family onsen baths
Etiquette: wash thoroughly before entering the bath
Ryokan stay usually includes traditional kaiseki dinner

days.neighborhoods: Hakone · Lake Ashi · Return to Tokyo
days.title: Lake Ashi Cruise, Hakone Shrine & Back to Tokyo
days.description: Morning cruise on Lake Ashi with Mt. Fuji reflections, the floating torii gate at Hakone Shrine, then the Romance Car express back to Tokyo for your final two days.

activities.name: Lake Ashi Pirate Ship Cruise
activities.description: Board a replica pirate ship and cruise across Lake Ashi. On clear mornings, Mt. Fuji reflects in the water. Ancient shrine in a cedar forest. The vermillion torii gate standing in the lake is one of Japan most photographed scenes.
details: Pirate ship departs from Togendai or Hakonemachi
Mt. Fuji views best in early morning before clouds form
Covered by Hakone Free Pass
The lakeside torii gate — arrive early to avoid photo queue
Beautiful forest walk to the main shrine

activities.name: Return to Tokyo via Romance Car
activities.description: Take the Odakyu Romance Car express from Hakone-Yumoto directly to Shinjuku — comfortable, scenic, no transfers.
details: Odakyu Romance Car — reserved seats, panoramic windows
Hakone-Yumoto to Shinjuku: ~85 min
Get window seats on the left side for valley views

activities.name: Shinjuku Reunion Night
activities.description: Back in Tokyo for the finale. Visit the Isetan department store basement food hall for gourmet souvenirs.
details: Isetan depachika (basement food hall) — gourmet paradise
Omoide Yokocho revisit — try different stalls

days.title: Tsukiji Market, Ginza & Tokyo GR Garage Farewell Night
days.description: Second-to-last day in Tokyo. Early sushi breakfast at Tsukiji, luxury shopping in Ginza, Toyota GR Garage car fix in Aoyama, then a farewell night in Shibuya.

activities.name: Tsukiji Outer Market — Sushi Breakfast
activities.description: The outer market is thriving. Fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, grilled seafood on sticks, and the best sashimi of your life.
details: Sushi Dai or Daiwa Sushi — legendary breakfast sushi (long queues)
Tsukiji Yamachou — fresh tamagoyaki sweet egg omelet
Street vendors with grilled scallops, uni, and crab sticks
Best 7-10am — most stalls close by early afternoon

activities.name: Ginza — Tokyo Luxury District
activities.description: Japan most upscale shopping district. Even just browsing, the architecture and food are worth the visit. Toyota Gazoo Racing lifestyle showroom. See the GR Supra, GR Yaris, GR86 and racing heritage up close. Free entry.
details: Ginza Six — stunning luxury mall with rooftop garden
Uniqlo Ginza flagship — 12 floors, Japan-exclusive items
Wako clock tower at Ginza 4-chome crossing — iconic
🏎️ Free entry — GR Supra, GR Yaris, GR86 on display
Racing simulators and GR merchandise
Short walk from Aoyama-Itchome Station

activities.name: Shibuya Night Farewell
activities.description: One last night at Shibuya Crossing — it hits different when you know it is your last time. The neon, the energy. Karaoke to close the night.
details: Night crossing photos from Shibuya Sky or Mag's Park rooftop
Karaoke — no Japan trip is complete without it
Craft beer bars in Shibuya if karaoke is not for you

days.title: Sayonara, Japan — Last Bites & Departure
days.description: Your last morning in Japan. Shinjuku Gyoen national garden for a peaceful farewell, a final convenience store run for Kit Kats and snacks, then departure.

activities.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
activities.description: A peaceful goodbye. This stunning garden combines Japanese, English, and French garden styles. Perfect for a quiet morning stroll before departure chaos. Do not underestimate Japan convenience stores. Stock up on Kit Kats (Japan-exclusive flavors), onigiri for the plane, and snacks.
details: Entry: 500 yen · Open 9am–4:30pm
Japanese garden with tea house, English landscape, French formal garden
A serene contrast to the Tokyo madness — beautiful final memory
Kit Kat flavors: matcha, strawberry cheesecake, sake, wasabi
Onigiri — salmon, tuna mayo, umeboshi for the flight
Cup noodles in weird flavors as souvenirs

activities.name: Airport and Departure
activities.description: Head to Narita or Haneda. Both airports have incredible shopping — last chance for Tokyo Banana, Royce chocolate, and Japanese whisky.
details: Allow 3 hours for international flights
Airport has amazing souvenir shops — Tokyo Banana, Royce chocolate
Airport sushi is actually excellent in Japan — one last roll
